jobs.description:
MDM Data Engineer with Profisee Experience

Exp Level-15+
Location: Dallas, TX (Hybrid)
Type: Contract

About the Role
You''ll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer — configure it, connect it, and keep golden records flowing cleanly into the downstream warehouse.
This is an implementation role, not an advisory one. You''ll write code, configure match rules, and debug pipeline failures.
What You''ll Do
• Configure and tune Profisee match and survivorship rules for Client and Advisor entities (probabilistic + deterministic matching, confidence thresholds, conflict resolution).
• Build and maintain the integration between Databricks Delta Lake and Profisee — ingestion of staging records into Profisee, and write-back of golden records to the Lakehouse.
• Set up the Profisee stewardship portal for data steward workflows — exception queues, match review, and record correction.
• Work with upstream pipeline engineers to ensure records are correctly partitioned and flagged before they hit the MDM layer.
• Monitor MDM pipeline health — match rates, queue depth, golden record lag — and fix issues when they arise.
• Document match rules, survivorship decisions, and integration patterns for the team.
Must-Have
• 3+ years with Profisee MDM — you''ve implemented it, not just administered it. You know match rules, survivorship policies, and Profisee Connect.
• Strong SQL and Python — you can write and debug pipeline code independently.
• Profisee integration experience — connecting Profisee to an external data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, or equivalent) via API or connector.
• Match/merge configuration — candidate generation, scoring, threshold tuning, and survivorship.
• Cloud environment experience — AWS or Azure.
Nice to Have
• Databricks / Delta Lake experience (DLT, MERGE, Change Data Feed).
• Financial services domain knowledge — client data, advisor data, accounts.
• Experience with other MDM tools (Reltio, Informatica, Semarchy).
• Kafka / event-driven pipeline experience.
You''re a Good Fit If…
• You can configure a Profisee match rule from scratch and explain why you set the thresholds where you did.
• You''ve debugged a golden record that wasn''t writing back correctly and can walk through how you found the issue.
• You don''t need someone to hand you an architecture diagram before you can ask good questions.

jobs.description:
Endpoint Platform Staff Engineer

THE POSITION Our roster has an opening with your name on it

As a Staff Endpoint Platform Engineer, you are the technical anchor of our endpoint fleet strategy - responsible for setting the course for how FanDuel manages, automates, and secures its device fleet at scale. You own the architecture. You drive the roadmap. You define what "secure and well-managed" means across macOS, iOS, Android, and Windows - and you build the systems, patterns, and standards that make it durable long after you've moved on to the next problem.

This isn't an execution-only role. You'll partner across Security, Enterprise Technology, and more to translate complex, ambiguous operational challenges into coherent platform solutions - and you'll mentor the engineers around you to do the same. You bring deep craft, organizational influence, and a bias toward solving problems permanently rather than repeatedly.

You will report to the Sr. Manager of Cyber Defense Engineering.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

• Define and own the multi-year technical strategy for FanDuel's global endpoint fleet - establishing engineering principles and reusable configuration patterns that set the standard for how our team builds and operates.
• Architect and drive delivery of scalable, secure-by-default device baselines across macOS, iOS, Android, and Windows - ensuring every device in the fleet is compliant, performant, and trusted from zero-touch provisioning through offboarding.
• Lead the design and implementation of GitOps-driven endpoint configuration management and CI/CD validation pipelines - ensuring platform changes are peer-reviewed, auditable, and resistant to configuration drift.
• Define the KPIs that matter - provisioning speed, compliance drift, patch latency, device trust posture - and build the telemetry and automation to track, report on, and continuously improve them.
• Mentor and develop engineers on the team by modeling technical excellence, providing thoughtful feedback, and investing in their craft.
• Proactively identify platform risks, technical debt, and emerging opportunities - and intervene when work is off-course to change direction before it becomes a bigger problem.
• Use AI as a force multiplier - for automation, operational efficiency, and engineering quality - across everything you do.
• Support the security organization as necessary. Anything is possible when we operate as one team.
THE STATS
What we're looking for in our next teammate

• Extensive hands-on experience architecting, designing, and managing large-scale Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and enterprise MDM platforms at scale - think Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, FleetDM, or equivalent - across multi-OS enterprise environments.
• Proven track record owning a platform strategy end-to-end - defining the roadmap, building alignment, navigating tradeoffs, and delivering durable outcomes across organizational boundaries.
• Strong automation and platform engineering depth - proficiency in Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python
• Hands-on experience deploying Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent) and GitOps workflows in production.
• Deep understanding of endpoint and mobile security ecosystems across iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows -Microsoft MAM, Secure Remote Access/Conditional Access approaches, and endpoint protection are a few you can expect to have impact in.
• Track record of mentoring and developing engineers - sharing knowledge broadly through documentation, design reviews, and direct coaching; actively participating in hiring and calibration for senior roles.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills - you can diagnose a complex fleet issue, translate the fix to non-technical stakeholders, and write the architecture doc that prevents the next one.
• Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments - able to set direction with incomplete information, raise blockers early, and drive to decisions even when consensus is hard.
ABOUT FANDUEL

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits , pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards . *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

A Fortune 500® company, EMCOR Group, Inc. (NYSE: EME) is a leader in mechanical and electrical construction, industrial and energy infrastructure, and building services. EMCOR companies plan, install, operate, maintain, and protect the sophisticated and dynamic systems that create facility environments—such as electrical, mechanical, lighting, air conditioning, heating, security, fire protection, and power generation systems—in virtually every sector of the economy and for a diverse range of businesses, organizations, and government.

Job Summary

EMCOR Group, Inc. seeks an Endpoint Administrator for a critical role responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-level endpoint solutions to ensure security, performance, scalability, and seamless operations. This position focuses on managing and resolving complex IT tickets from our network of over 150 IT professionals while collaborating with local IT teams and other stakeholders across EMCOR’s 100 operating companies. The Endpoint Administrator will leverage Microsoft Intune for devise management across Windows, iOS, and Android platforms, performing basic design and advanced troubleshooting to support our business objectives.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Design, test, validate, and deploy enterprise-scale endpoint solutions, including device configurations, OS deployments, and software distribution using Microsoft Intune. Triage and resolve complex IT tickets escalated from operating company IT teams, ensuring timely and effective solutions. Create and maintain standardized configurations for desktops, laptops, and mobile devices, ensuring compatibility with existing and new hardware. Document endpoint environments, configurations, deployments, and changes to maintain a clear and accurate knowledge base. Support pilot programs to evaluate new technologies and ensure compatibility with existing infrastructure. Provide escalated support and troubleshooting for complex endpoint issues, serving as a subject matter expert for endpoint management. Automate routing tasks using scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, PSADT) to improve efficiency. Package and deploy Win32 applications via Intune and Patch My PC, ensuring seamless software distribution. Stay current with industry trends by participating in conferences, workshops, and training. Conduct regular knowledge-sharing sessions with internal teams to promote best practices and new technologies while fostering innovation and collaboration across the organization.

Qualifications

#emcor

Minimum of 3 years of experience managing Windows devices with Microsoft Intune, including MAM/MDM administration. Minimum of 3 years of experience with imaging and Windows Autopilot provisioning. Associate’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred); equivalent experience considered. Expertise in operating systems, including Windows 11, iOS, macOS, and Android. Advanced knowledge of Apple Business Manager (Automated Device Enrollment, VPP applications) and Android Zero-touch enrollment. Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, PSADT) for task automation. Experience packaging and deploying Win32 applications via Intune and Patch My PC. Strong problem solving, decision making, and troubleshooting skills. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently or collaboratively in a team environment. Excellent communication skills to interact effectively with personnel at all levels. Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and maintaining positive interpersonal relationships.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.

Do you want to spend your days building technology that helps protect people and organizations around the world? Do you enjoy diving deep into the Windows operating system and bringing together components across the kernel, user mode, and shell to solve complex problems?

Become an integral member of the Microsoft Defender – Endpoint Protection Client team and help protect consumers and enterprises from cyber-attacks. Our mission is to safeguard users through innovative, proactive protection, detection, and response technologies that stay ahead of todays threats while anticipating those of tomorrow.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of developers designing and building the next generation of Endpoint Protection Client capabilities, including Agentic Protection and defenses against supply chain attacks. Youll help champion engineering fundamentals such as performance, reliability, and scalability across platforms of all sizes, while partnering closely with our Endpoint Research organization to build the foundational technologies that detect and protect against current and emerging threats.

The team offers significant opportunities for professional growth and development. Youll collaborate across organizational boundaries, gain a broad understanding of Microsofts business, and contribute to technology that helps secure millions of users and organizations worldwide.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Partner with multiple teams across Microsoft, architecting and implementing solutions deeply integrated into the Defender stack. Execute on architecture, design, code reviews, and development.Foster a healthy and inclusive team environment. Embody our culture and values.Qualifications

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

- Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

- Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

- Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

- Experience with OSquery and Santa

- Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

- Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

Sierra Space Careers:

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About The Role

The Systems Engineer III contributes to the development and implementation of advanced system solutions by providing alignment, connection and direction to the technical team throughout the product development lifecycle. The Systems Engineer III represents the viewpoint of the integrated whole during system development and works to glue segments and subsystems together via top-down decomposition of stakeholder requirements, traceability through development artifacts, and bottom-up validation and verification of the system. They help to shepherd the team through technical development milestones, track performance measures and identify technical risks to arrive at a compliant and cohesive system solution. The Systems Engineer III is an emerging leader in Systems Engineering principles and is proficient in the majority of systems engineering skills including requirements management, system architecture development, concept of operation definition, system integration and system verification. The Systems Engineer III may lead small teams to execute systems engineering scope.

In this role, you will specify, architect, and integrate complex system solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts to understand project requirements and objectives. You will derive, decompose, allocate, trace, and manage system requirements and architectures, as well as define and document system concepts of operation. Supporting development milestone reviews by creating artifacts and deliverables will be a key responsibility, alongside overseeing system integration and verification activities to ensure system functionality and performance. You will identify and manage technical risks, develop mitigation strategies, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying areas for enhancement. Adhering to established engineering processes and standards will be essential, and you will communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to ensure project alignment and successful execution.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Description

Our client an international law firm is seeking a Cloud Delivery Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and ongoing delivery of Cloud services with Microsoft Intune, Exchange Online, Entra ID. This role owns the design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of Intune MDM/MAM, Exchange Online, Entra ID Conditional Access, and mobile security controls.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design and implementation of Intune policies tied to MAM and MDM for BYOD and Corporate Devices

• Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Intune for iOS/iPadOS and Android Enterprise

• Define and enforce mobile data protection controls through Intune App Protection Policies and Devices Restrictions

• Manage data sharing access between managed apps

• Implement and maintain device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines aligned to the firm’s security and regulatory requirements.

• Act as the escalation point for Mobile Intune Applications, MAM, and Conditional Access issues, Exchange Online

• Must be comfortable with other Azure services that directly affect Mobile devices Authentication, Authorization, Application Deployment and Exchange Online Connectivity

• Conditional Access Policies

• Azure App Proxy

• Azure VPN for iOS and Android

• Entra Sign-in Logs

• Define and troubleshoot Entra Conditional Access Policies

• Multifactor Authentication and Certificate Base Authentication

• Entra application registrations

• Have a solid understanding of Exchange Online, including mail flow, security, and coexistence with any on-premises or legacy systems

• On-premises to Exchange Online Migration

• High level of comfort with Entra ID (Azure AD) identity services, including MFA, SSO, application registrations, access governance, and privileged identity management.

• Work closely with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure Microsoft 365 and Azure services support client obligations, including confidentiality and data residency.

• Comfortable with Microsoft Defender solutions (Endpoint, Office 365) as part of the firm’s security posture.

• Lead or act as engineer on global projects involving Microsoft 365, Intune, and related infrastructure.

• Develop and maintain technical standards, documentation, diagrams, and runbooks for operational teams.

• Provide escalation support for complex incidents and problems related to Microsoft 365, Intune, and Azure services.

• Mentor junior engineers and service desk analysts, sharing knowledge and best practices.

• Monitor platform health, performance, and capacity; recommend and implement improvements for availability, resilience, and cost optimization.

• Stay current with the Microsoft roadmap; assess new features and changes and lead their adoption within the firm where appropriate.

• Perform additional tasks as needed.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent field required.

• 5 - 7 years of experience required.

• Microsoft certifications are highly desirable.

• Extensive hands-on experience administering large enterprise Microsoft 365 tenants, including Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Entra ID (Azure AD).

• Proven experience building and managing Intune-based endpoint management at scale, including Autopilot, app deployment, and cross-platform device management.

• Strong expertise in Conditional Access, App Protection Policies, and compliance policies for secure hybrid/BYOD access.

• Solid understanding of security and compliance features in Microsoft Defender solutions.

• Proficient in PowerShell scripting and automation for Microsoft 365 and Azure.

• Experience working in a law firm or similarly regulated environment strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects, manage stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a global organization.

Intune, MDM, MAM, Application Protection, Entra ID, MS 365, Exchange Online, Powershell

Job Title: SentinelOne Endpoint Security Engineer
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SentinelOne Endpoint Security Engineer to manage, secure, and optimize our enterprise endpoint security environment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with SentinelOne EPP/EDR, Microsoft Intune, Windows endpoint administration, and PowerShell automation. jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

- Global-level admin experience with Microsoft Intune

- Ability to script in Powershell

- Admin experience with 1Password Enterprise Password Manager (EPM)

What you can expect:

- Lead the planning and implementation of large-scale device infrastructure projects with broad impact across the organization

- Drive IT Change Management initiatives related to endpoint management, software patching, and fleet operations

- Manage and administer cloud-based Apple MDM platforms (Iru), including custom configuration profiles and advanced policy management

- Apply AI tooling to real infrastructure problems (automated remediation, smarter alerting, reducing the manual toil that slows device ops) and have a hand in deciding where it goes next.

- Own third-party software patching workflows that keep the fleet current with minimal disruption to employees

- Approach all rollouts with a strong user experience focus. Phasing thoughtfully, communicating proactively, and designing for minimal disruption

- Contribute to designing and implementing best practices, policies, and procedures for the Device Infrastructure Services team

- Build relationships with key stakeholders across the organization

- Be available for occasional 24/7 on-call shifts to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve incidents.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $117,000 USD and $164,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $103,000 CAD and $144,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

KECH is seeking an experienced and versatile Systems Engineer to support the company’s information technology infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, end-user computing environment, and contact-center technology platforms. The position is REMOTE with the occasional requirement of being IN-OFFICE. Applicants must be located near a KECH office location in Williamsburg, KY or El Paso, TX.

This position will be responsible for administering servers, desktops, networks, identity systems, security technologies, and business-critical applications. The Systems Engineer will also assist with cybersecurity monitoring, incident response, vulnerability scanning and remediation, system hardening, technology evaluations, and compliance activities.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working across multiple technical disciplines and resolving issues involving servers, endpoints, networks, cloud services, cybersecurity tools, telecommunications, and call-center platforms. This is a hands-on position suited for an experienced IT professional who can independently troubleshoot complex problems while working collaboratively with internal teams, vendors, customers, and technology partners.

Key Responsibilities

Server and Systems Administration

Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Windows and Linux Server environments.
Support physical servers, virtual servers, cloud-hosted systems, and related infrastructure.
Administer server operating systems, system services, storage, permissions, scheduled tasks, and applications.
Monitor server availability, performance, capacity, event logs, and system health.
Perform server patching, upgrades, maintenance, and remediation activities.
Assist with backup administration, restoration testing, business continuity, and disaster-recovery planning.
Troubleshoot server, operating-system, application, authentication, and performance issues.
Maintain system configurations, inventories, diagrams, procedures, and administrative documentation.

Desktop and End-User Computing

Configure, deploy, administer, and support desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and related equipment.
Build and maintain standardized workstation images and device configurations.
Manage endpoint patching, software deployment, configuration management, and security policies.
Troubleshoot Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, browsers, productivity tools, and business applications.
Support endpoint encryption, antivirus, EDR/XDR, web filtering, multifactor authentication, and device-security controls.
Manage hardware and software inventories throughout the technology lifecycle.
Assist users with technical issues while providing professional and responsive customer service.
Identify recurring support problems and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Network Administration

Configure, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot local-area and wide-area network infrastructure.
Support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VPNs, VLANs, and internet connectivity.
Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and connectivity issues.
Assist with network segmentation, firewall rules, remote-access solutions, and secure connectivity.
Monitor network availability, utilization, performance, and security events.
Maintain network diagrams, device inventories, configuration records, and administrative documentation.
Coordinate with internet, telecommunications, managed-service, and equipment providers.
Support Ubiquiti or comparable network technologies.
Assist with the design and implementation of secure network improvements.

Cybersecurity Operations

Monitor and investigate security alerts.
Assist with incidents involving phishing, malware, ransomware, credential theft, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and insider threats.
Support incident containment, eradication, recovery, documentation, and post-incident review activities.
Administer or support Trend Micro Vision One.
Manage or support website allowlists, blocklists, DNS filtering, and secure web-gateway technologies.
Conduct proactive reviews of endpoint, server, identity, cloud, and network-security events.
Maintain incident-response procedures, investigation records, corrective-action plans, and lessons-learned documentation.
Escalate significant incidents to management and appropriate internal teams.
Assist with security-awareness activities and employee cybersecurity training.

Vulnerability Management and System Hardening

Perform or coordinate vulnerability scanning.
Analyze vulnerability findings and prioritize remediation based on severity, exploitability, asset criticality, and operational risk.
Coordinate remediation activities involving servers, workstations, network devices, applications, and cloud systems.
Validate that vulnerabilities have been successfully remediated.
Apply or recommend security-hardening controls based on CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs, vendor guidance, and organizational standards.
Track vulnerability-aging, remediation status, exceptions, and accepted risks.
Prepare technical reports and management dashboards showing vulnerability trends and remediation progress.
Identify weaknesses in the technology environment and recommend practical corrective actions.

Technology Evaluation and Implementation

Evaluate new hardware, software, cloud services, cybersecurity products, artificial-intelligence tools, and business applications.
Identify security, privacy, integration, support, licensing, and operational risks before implementation.
Assist with proofs of concept, application testing, system validation, and implementation planning.
Prepare recommendations that describe business benefits, technical requirements, costs, risks, and alternatives.
Participate in technology deployments, upgrades, migrations, integrations, and decommissioning projects.
Confirm that new systems meet security, performance, supportability, and business requirements.

Help Desk and Operational Support

Serve as an escalation point for complex help-desk and technical-support issues.
Diagnose and resolve problems involving hardware, software, networks, authentication, servers, security tools, and business applications.
Prioritize incidents based on business impact, urgency, security risk, and contractual requirements.
Document troubleshooting activities, resolutions, root causes, and follow-up actions.
Participate in an after-hours or on-call support rotation when required.
Support remote locations, distributed employees, call-center operations, and customer-facing systems.
Coordinate planned maintenance to minimize operational disruption.
Communicate outages, service interruptions, security events, and recovery status clearly to affected stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in systems administration, network administration, cybersecurity, technical support, or a closely related field.
Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows and Linux server environments.
Experience configuring or troubleshooting routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and VLANs.
Experience with endpoint-management, patch-management, software-deployment, or configuration-management technologies.
Experience supporting Microsoft 365 services and applications.

Working knowledge of cybersecurity incident response, security hardening, access control, and vulnerability remediation.
Experience applying CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIGs or similar standards.
Experience with backup, disaster-recovery, monitoring, ticketing, automation, and remote-management technologies.

Under the general direction of next level leader and with guidance from Senior Engineers, the End User Computing Engineer is responsible for the hardware, software, and its connectivity to the network infrastructure that end-users rely on for their work. They provide technical support, troubleshoot issues, and manage the lifecycle of user devices and applications.The End User Computing Engineer provides specialized technical support, consultation, and training services, coordinating and assisting in developing standards for enterprise end user device technologies. This role involves working with users at all levels of the organization and IS teams to support end user devices. Technical knowledge of end user technologies, such as client/server operating systems, end-point management systems and desktop support management software systems, is required.

Conduct device analysis, configuration, implementation, upgrades, troubleshooting, and installation of end user devices and software systems.

Collaborate with users at all levels of the organization toidentifyoperational needs and explore information systems options.

Test end user devices to ensure they are functioning effectively before implementation or installation.

Partner with key stakeholders to analyze workflows, drive process improvements, and achieve favorable patient-centric outcomes.

Work on assignments related to end user devices or other sections of projects and report on project task statuses.

Provide initial and ongoing training and education for users on the operation of end user devices.

Preparesupport documentation and knowledge documentation as needed.

Strong Customer Service Skills

Ability to work well independently

Work-Life Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO) combines vacation, sick, and personal days into one balance to allow you the flexibility to use your time off as you need

Professional Development:Support for your career growth through Professional Development Opportunities, our Tuition Investment Program, and our Career Development Center

Additional Employee Discounts and PerksOther benefits include a Wellness program with incentives, employer-paid life insurance and AD&D, optional short-term and long-term disability coverage, an employee assistance program, identity theft protection, pet insurance, Inspire & Celebrate colleague recognition and rewards program, a discount program, and more!

Senior Windows Engineer

Salary: Up to $150,000 to Start

Work Arrangement: Hybrid – 2–3 Days per Week Onsite

Location: Corporate Headquarters – East Windsor, NJ

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Windows Platform Engineer to help architect, engineer, automate, and modernize a complex enterprise infrastructure environment.

This is not a traditional Windows Systems Administrator position focused primarily on monitoring systems, resolving routine tickets, creating user accounts, or performing repetitive maintenance. We are looking for a true infrastructure engineer who can take ownership of production platforms, establish technical standards, design scalable solutions, automate operational processes, and lead infrastructure initiatives from architecture through implementation.

The ideal candidate will have command across the major domains of enterprise infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware virtualization, SAN storage, backup and recovery, Azure cloud services, endpoint management, automation, and platform security.

This role leans heavily toward a DevOps-minded, production engineering approach, with an emphasis on Infrastructure as Code, automation, reliability, standardization, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

Architect, engineer, and maintain enterprise Windows infrastructure supporting business-critical production environments.Establish scalable platform standards across Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, VMware, storage, backup, and endpoint management technologies.Design highly available, secure, resilient, and supportable infrastructure solutions.Lead infrastructure projects from initial requirements and architecture through engineering, implementation, documentation, and production handoff.Develop PowerShell automation for provisioning, configuration, patching, reporting, compliance, remediation, and operational workflows.Reduce manual administrative work by introducing repeatable automation, standardized configurations, and engineering best practices.Engineer and optimize VMware environments, including ESXi, vCenter, clusters, virtual networking, storage integration, capacity planning, and lifecycle management.Support the architecture and integration of enterprise SAN storage platforms.Design and improve backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.Engineer and modernize Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft Entra ID, identity services, authentication, and access management.Support the transition from traditional Group Policy and device-management practices toward modern management through Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager.Design and support hybrid infrastructure solutions spanning on-premises environments and Microsoft Azure.Partner with cloud, security, networking, application, database, and operations teams to deliver reliable production platforms.Improve platform observability, monitoring, performance, security, recoverability, and operational readiness.Serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex infrastructure and production issues.Evaluate existing platforms, identify technical debt, and recommend modernization strategies.Create architecture diagrams, technical standards, engineering documentation, implementation plans, and operational runbooks.Mentor other engineers and provide technical direction across infrastructure initiatives.

Required Experience

Extensive experience engineering enterprise Windows infrastructure in complex, production-based environments.Advanced knowledge of Windows Server architecture, engineering, security, troubleshooting, patching, and lifecycle management.Strong Active Directory expertise, including domain architecture, Group Policy, DNS, authentication, replication, trusts, and identity integration.Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity environments.Advanced PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation experience.Strong VMware virtualization experience, including ESXi and vCenter.Experience engineering or supporting enterprise SAN storage environments.Strong knowledge of enterprise backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and data-protection technologies.Experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure services and hybrid cloud architecture.Experience with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager.Strong understanding of infrastructure security, high availability, capacity planning, performance, monitoring, and production reliability.Experience leading technical projects from design through implementation.Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across multiple infrastructure domains.Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical recommendations to both engineering teams and business leadership.

Ideal Background

The strongest candidates will have experience working as a senior infrastructure engineer, platform engineer, systems engineer, or infrastructure architect within a large, highly available production environment.

We are especially interested in engineers who approach infrastructure as a platform—using automation, reusable standards, source control, documentation, and repeatable deployment processes rather than relying on manual administration.

Experience with technologies or practices such as Terraform, Bicep, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, observability, or Site Reliability Engineering is highly desirable.

What This Role Is Not

This is not a position centered on basic systems administration, routine user support, passive monitoring, or ticket-based maintenance.

The person hired will be expected to:

Architect solutions rather than simply maintain existing configurations.Engineer and automate platforms rather than rely on repetitive manual processes.Improve production reliability rather than only respond to outages.Establish standards rather than work entirely from existing procedures.Take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure initiatives.

Compensation and Schedule

This is a full-time, permanent position offering a starting salary of up to $150,000, depending on experience.

We are seeking a skilled Endpoint Management System Administrator to support and operate a modern enterprise endpoint environment. This is a highly hands-on operational role responsible for administering and maintaining enterprise endpoint management platforms, with daily use of Microsoft Intune and Tanium to manage endpoint configuration, compliance, patching, and software deployments.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing Windows and macOS endpoints, with working knowledge of Linux, and will be comfortable performing daily endpoint administration tasks using Microsoft Intune and Tanium. These platforms are used extensively for endpoint visibility, machine compliance, vulnerability remediation, software updates, and software deployments. Jamf is also used to manage macOS systems within the environment.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

Administer and support enterprise endpoints across Windows desktops and servers, macOS, and Linux.

Use Microsoft Intune and Tanium as primary endpoint management platforms for daily endpoint administration and operational management such as:

Endpoint visibility and real-time inventory

Machine compliance monitoring and enforcement

Operating system and third-party software updates

Software packaging, deployments, and remediation

Vulnerability identification and remediation

Manage Windows endpoints using Microsoft Intune and Group Policy Objects (GPO).

Manage macOS endpoints using Jamf, including configuration profiles, policies, and application deployments.

Execute and track vulnerability remediation efforts, ensuring timely patching and risk reduction across all endpoint platforms.

Support and maintain enterprise cloud print solutions.

Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and service teams to ensure endpoint configurations align with security standards and operational requirements.

Implementation and management of endpoint security baselines and configuration standards aligned with CIS Security Controls.

Create and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, and operational runbooks.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on strengthening endpoint security, automation, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Minimum of Three (3) years of relevant experience

Proven experience managing enterprise desktops and servers in a large-scale environment.

Hands-on operational experience administering endpoints using Microsoft Intune.Strong working knowledge of:

Microsoft Intune (Windows endpoint management)

Windows Autopilot

Group Policy (GPO)

Jamf (macOS management)

Experience administering Windows desktop and server environments.

Working knowledge of macOS and Linux administration.

Demonstrated experience managing machine compliance, software patching, and vulnerability remediation.

Strong troubleshooting skills and experience operating in a large, complex enterprise environment.

Experience implementing or supporting device compliance policies and their integration with conditional access controls using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID.

Preferred Qualifications

Additional hands-on experience using Tanium for endpoint management, compliance reporting, patching, and software deployment.

Experience managing third-party application updates across diverse endpoint platforms.

Familiarity with modern endpoint security concepts such as least privilege, zero trust, and compliance baselines.

jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer — MDM (Profisee)

Location: Dallas, TX (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time | Contract

About the Role

You''ll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer — configure it, connect it, and keep golden records flowing cleanly into the downstream warehouse.

This is an implementation role, not an advisory one. You''ll write code, configure match rules, and debug pipeline failures.

What You''ll Do

· Configure and tune Profisee match and survivorship rules for Client and Advisor entities (probabilistic + deterministic matching, confidence thresholds, conflict resolution).

· Build and maintain the integration between Databricks Delta Lake and Profisee — ingestion of staging records into Profisee, and write-back of golden records to the Lakehouse.

· Set up the Profisee stewardship portal for data steward workflows — exception queues, match review, and record correction.

· Work with upstream pipeline engineers to ensure records are correctly partitioned and flagged before they hit the MDM layer.

· Monitor MDM pipeline health — match rates, queue depth, golden record lag — and fix issues when they arise.

· Document match rules, survivorship decisions, and integration patterns for the team.

Must-Have

· 3+ years with Profisee MDM — you''ve implemented it, not just administered it. You know match rules, survivorship policies, and Profisee Connect.

· Strong SQL and Python — you can write and debug pipeline code independently.

· Profisee integration experience — connecting Profisee to an external data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, or equivalent) via API or connector.

· Match/merge configuration — candidate generation, scoring, threshold tuning, and survivorship.

· Cloud environment experience — AWS or Azure.

Nice to Have

· Databricks / Delta Lake experience (DLT, MERGE, Change Data Feed).

· Financial services domain knowledge — client data, advisor data, accounts.

· Experience with other MDM tools (Reltio, Informatica, Semarchy).

· Kafka / event-driven pipeline experience.

You must be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship (U.S. citizens or green card holders only)You must live within commuting distance of downtown Columbus, Ohio.

Organization Summary

FCDC provides cost-effective, business-driven, collaborative, and secure IT services and solutions to public service agencies throughout Ohio’s most dynamic county. Our goals are simple but expansive: to be the most trusted enterprise technology service provider for Franklin County and a national leader in digital government services. Every day the FCDC team empowers local government departments, agencies, teams, and nonprofits to deliver top-notch services to residents and businesses in central Ohio, and we take pride in the work they accomplish with our support.

Job Summary

Endpoint Engineers play a critical role in architecting and caring for the digital experience of Franklin County employees. They continuously research, design, deploy, administer, monitor, and collaboratively support complex end user hardware-and-software solutions (endpoints) that put the power of modern technologies into the hands of thousands of colleagues every day, each of whom plays a role in delivering vital public services to central Ohio residents.

Our best Endpoint Engineers think deeply about how our end users experience their PCs, smartphones, and other tech at their fingertips—not just how those devices are configured technically. Our Engineers manage endpoint features and lifecycles with tools like Microsoft Intune, but the “north star” for this role is to continuously answer this question: Does this technology make someone's workday easier, faster, and less frustrating?

If you believe Microsoft, Apple, and Google products—out of the box—are just not ready for normal users, and you’re ready to actively partner with our Help Desk team, our Security team, and our customers to build a better user experience, then this is the job for you.

This is the “it just works” team, ensuring our public servants get trustworthy digital Swiss Army knives they can use intuitively anywhere, anytime.

Employees new to FCDC or promoted into new positions must complete a 180-day probationary period, and all employees must adhere to current Employee Handbook policies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, Endpoint Engineers must be able to carry out each essential duty in a reliable and user‑focused manner. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The following responsibilities apply to all Endpoint Engineer levels (1, 2, and 3):

Support Windows client environments—including device configuration, Group Policy consumption, and Active Directory user/device object management—while maintaining readiness to assist with additional operating systems as they are adopted.Assist with Microsoft 365 application management and troubleshooting (Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint), Azure AD groups and permissions, and endpoint-related Enterprise Mobility Suite features in collaboration with peer teams.Use and maintain endpoint management tools such as Intune, Autopilot, SCCM, and MDM solutions in partnership with Enterprise Support and Security teams.Plan, schedule, and communicate client-impacting upgrade or maintenance events, ensuring coordination with application owners and users.Help produce documented testing and integration plans for onboarding new client systems, applications, and services.Follow established change management procedures for all client-related deployments, fixes, and configuration updates.Create and maintain clear documentation for endpoint processes, build steps, configuration standards, and client-related cloud workflow diagrams.Stay current on industry trends and emerging endpoint technologies that support modern device management.Identify opportunities to improve device performance, user experience, productivity tools, and endpoint service efficiency.Ensure endpoint operations align with regulatory requirements, audit standards, and organizational policies.Monitor M365 and related client applications for issues, outages, degraded performance, and functional impacts.Participate in ITIL‑based incident management and limited on‑call rotations, providing user‑focused troubleshooting, escalation, and resolution during regular and after‑hours support.Directly encourage professional and skills development in junior engineers and analysts and support cross-training efforts.Endpoint Engineers must also collaborate with a variety of FCDC teams, including:

IT leadership and architecture teams to align endpoint strategies with broader FCDC initiatives, and to provide input on device‑related policies, standards, and roadmaps.Support teams on equipment lifecycle activities, including device provisioning, refresh planning, and retirement workflows.Financial Services for vendor evaluations, hardware and software procurement, contract renewals, and coordinating third‑party service engagements.Server, Storage, and Cloud teams on client‑related integrations, without owning server/network infrastructure.Third‑party vendors to assist with device support, hardware services, application updates, and endpoint-focused projects.Project Managers and internal clients to support system upgrades, client-side maintenance tasks, technical debt remediation, and project planning activities—including work breakdown details, labor hour estimates, and technical requirements.All other FCDC technical and service delivery teams to ensure smooth cross-functional operations and a consistent, user‑focused technology experience.All other duties as assigned.Additional Information

Note: Levels 1, 2, and 3 are distinguished by specific measures of performance, education, and experience. The tables below outline standard boundaries between each of the levels. Keep in mind that years of service alone is not sufficient justification for promotion. An employee must demonstrate consistent next-level performance to become eligible for promotion.

jobs.description:
Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

We are seeking a skilled Endpoint Management System Administrator to support and operate a modern enterprise endpoint environment. This is a highly hands-on operational role responsible for administering and maintaining enterprise endpoint management platforms, with daily use of Microsoft Intune and Tanium to manage endpoint configuration, compliance, patching, and software deployments.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing Windows and macOS endpoints, with working knowledge of Linux, and will be comfortable performing daily endpoint administration tasks using Microsoft Intune and Tanium. These platforms are used extensively for endpoint visibility, machine compliance, vulnerability remediation, software updates, and software deployments. Jamf is also used to manage macOS systems within the environment.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

Administer and support enterprise endpoints across Windows desktops and servers, macOS, and Linux.

Use Microsoft Intune and Tanium as primary endpoint management platforms for daily endpoint administration and operational management such as:

Endpoint visibility and real-time inventory

Machine compliance monitoring and enforcement

Operating system and third-party software updates

Software packaging, deployments, and remediation

Vulnerability identification and remediation

Manage Windows endpoints using Microsoft Intune and Group Policy Objects (GPO).

Manage macOS endpoints using Jamf, including configuration profiles, policies, and application deployments.

Execute and track vulnerability remediation efforts, ensuring timely patching and risk reduction across all endpoint platforms.

Support and maintain enterprise cloud print solutions.

Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and service teams to ensure endpoint configurations align with security standards and operational requirements.

Implementation and management of endpoint security baselines and configuration standards aligned with CIS Security Controls.

Create and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, and operational runbooks.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on strengthening endpoint security, automation, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Minimum of Three (3) years of relevant experience

Proven experience managing enterprise desktops and servers in a large-scale environment.

Hands-on operational experience administering endpoints using Microsoft Intune.Strong working knowledge of:

Microsoft Intune (Windows endpoint management)

Windows Autopilot

Group Policy (GPO)

Jamf (macOS management)

Experience administering Windows desktop and server environments.

Working knowledge of macOS and Linux administration.

Demonstrated experience managing machine compliance, software patching, and vulnerability remediation.

Strong troubleshooting skills and experience operating in a large, complex enterprise environment.

Experience implementing or supporting device compliance policies and their integration with conditional access controls using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID.

Preferred Qualifications

Additional hands-on experience using Tanium for endpoint management, compliance reporting, patching, and software deployment.

Experience managing third-party application updates across diverse endpoint platforms.

Familiarity with modern endpoint security concepts such as least privilege, zero trust, and compliance baselines.

Experience supporting cloud-first or hybrid endpoint management strategies.

Compensation & Benefits

The expected pay range will be $95,000 - $105,000. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.

Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; based on the type of position

Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.

Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.

Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.

Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.

Description

Leidos has upcoming opportunities for Systems Engineers to join our team at Fort Meade in Maryland. These are hybrid positions that are primarily on-site, with opportunity for 1-2 remote days per week depending on mission needs. Our recruiting team will contact applicants as positions become available - we expect to begin onboarding in late summer 2026.

These positions will join a complex, multi-year contract providing Systems Engineering and Integration support to DISA. The work performed on this Leidos-led prime contract is mission-critical and offers team members the opportunity to work autonomously while developing expertise in cross domain technologies.

Our Systems Engineers will support a high priority, high visibility development, integration, and implementation effort for a mission-critical DISA Cross Domain program. The selected candidate will contribute to multiple concurrent tasks and collaborate across engineering and mission teams. The successful candidate will be a motivated, forward-leaning engineer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to grow into more senior responsibilities within a dynamic customer environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates a commitment to delivering high-quality work, continuous learning, and effective collaboration within a team environment. This individual is expected to quickly come up to speed, operate with a high degree of autonomy, and proactively contribute to mission objectives. The role requires the ability to adapt to evolving priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail and technical excellence.

Primary Responsibilities include:

Support decomposition of customer and system requirements in alignment with cross-domain roadmaps.

Assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of cross domain systems and infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage systems, and software applications.

Strong understanding to configure and maintain physical and virtual environments, including VMware and ESXi systems.

Apply and validate system security configurations, including DISA STIGs (Security Technical Implementation Guides), to ensure compliance with security requirements.

Perform hands-on hardware and software configuration of systems, including network configuration and cabling.

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and support development of technical solutions aligned with mission and security objectives.

Install, configure, and troubleshoot IT system components to ensure stability and performance.

Work with customers, mission partners, program managers, and other technical team members to support system integration activities.

Assist in the creation and maintenance of automation scripts (e.g. Ansible, Python, Bash, etc..) to streamline deployments, support internal lab environment projects and perfective maintenance priorities of the program.

Provide support to system infrastructure, network security, and Authorization & Accreditation (A&A) activities.

Develop and maintain technical documentation and assist with Engineering Implementation Plans.
