jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior IT Systems Engineer with proven experience in systems and network administration for both on-premises and cloud based systems (Azure). You will contribute to the design, administration, and troubleshooting of core infrastructure services across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, Azure, servers, network, storage, and backup platforms. This position requires strong technical fundamentals, practical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to support secure, reliable IT services in a fast-paced environment with 24x7 support.

Key Responsibilities:

Systems Engineering: Provide infrastructure support across servers, Active Directory, storage, backup platforms, endpoint services, virtualization, and other critical systems under the guidance of Lead and Senior Engineers.
Networking & Connectivity: Support and troubleshoot enterprise networking services, including LAN/WAN, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, VPN, wireless, segmentation, and connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments.
Azure & Microsoft Cloud Administration: Support Azure and Microsoft 365 infrastructure services, including identity, access, security controls, Azure networking, monitoring, and cloud-based infrastructure components.
Microsoft Copilot & AI Support: Help administer, secure, and support Microsoft Copilot and other AI platforms, including user enablement, access controls, data protection considerations, adoption support, and troubleshooting.
Security Monitoring: Track and analyze alerts from SIEM and security tools to identify unusual activity, reduce risk, and escalate potential incidents when appropriate.
Incident Response: Support the identification, triage, analysis, and resolution of security incidents or breaches, including documentation of findings, containment steps, and lessons learned.
Vulnerability Management & Threat Intelligence: Work within our vulnerability management systems to detect, prioritize, and assist with remediation of security vulnerabilities across Windows and Linux systems, network devices, IoT, cloud services, and other enterprise assets and stay informed on emerging cybersecurity threats, cloud security trends, and networking risks, contributing to the improvement of security policies, standards, and operational procedures.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain clear records of configuration changes, security events, investigations, remediation activities, network diagrams, and operational procedures for management and technical teams.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional IT teams, business users, vendors, and leadership to implement security controls, improve service reliability, and enhance the overall security posture.
Escalation & Advanced Support: Serve as an escalation point for service desk and end-user support issues, ensuring timely resolution of complex technical problems and providing guidance to IT support staff.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity) preferred or equivalent professional experience.
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure support, cybersecurity operations, network administration, Microsoft 365 administration, Azure administration, or a closely related technical role.
Microsoft 365 & Copilot: Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and a strong interest in Microsoft Copilot administration, governance, security, adoption, and user support.
Azure Skills: Working knowledge of Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management, Azure networking, monitoring, security controls, and cloud infrastructure administration.
Networking Skills: Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, routing, switching, VLANs, VPN, firewall concepts, wireless, and common troubleshooting tools.
Operating Systems: Advanced knowledge of Windows Server, Windows desktop, and Linux operating systems, including patching, hardening, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Security Tools: Experience with vulnerability management platforms, endpoint security tools, SIEM solutions, Microsoft Defender technologies, or similar security platforms is preferred.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and the ability to work through ambiguous technical issues.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical, security, cloud, and networking concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively within a team-oriented environment while taking ownership of assigned tasks and follow-through.
Eagerness to Learn: Passion for ongoing professional development in cybersecurity, Microsoft cloud services, AI-enabled productivity tools, networking, and systems engineering.

Preferred Experience:

Microsoft 365 administration, Microsoft Copilot administration/support, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, or Intune.
Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual networks, VPN gateways, network security groups, and cloud monitoring.
Firewall administration, routing/switching, wireless networking, SD-WAN, WAN optimization, or network segmentation.
PowerShell scripting, automation, reporting, or administration of enterprise IT systems.
Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator, Microsoft 365 Administrator, Security+, Network+, CCNA, or equivalent practical experience.

We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.

As a Security Engineer working on our infrastructure, you will be a crucial part of our IT and Security team. Your work will improve and increase our hardening and defense of Reliable’s internal infrastructure. You will work closely with Client Platform engineers and the rest of the IT team to build and deploy our managed security tools.

Efforts will involve client platform onboarding automation, reviewing cloud solutions and configurations and adapting them to our needs. You will focus heavily on securing the end-user experience by providing secure solutions.

Responsibilities In your role as Security Engineer you will be responsible for the design, implementation and monitoring of security tools supporting the business’ internal needs and safety requirements. You will be involved in securing daily drivers, as well as supporting development infrastructure for our products.

EDR and client security: Partnering with the client platform team, and working with affected users, you will be responsible for enforcing security configurations on all endpoints (macOS, Windows, iOS, Android) utilizing the appropriate tools for the job.

Automation & Infra: Meet the automation requirements of the team by taking advantage of infrastructure as code systems in supported use, building reproducible solutions with adequate documentation to repair and manage those systems and being open to critique.

Incident Response and Ops work: Be able to perform Log Analysis, participate in threat hunting exercises and be capable of investigating security alerts from EDR or externally provided IOCs.

Collaboration and resilience: At Reliable we design robust systems for the purpose at hand that are easy to maintain. We demand the same level of collaboration and resiliency between our teams and our systems.

5+ years of experience in an IT/Infrastructure Security, Security Operations (SecOps), or Corporate Infrastructure Security role.

Strong, fundamental understanding of endpoint operating systems (macOS and Windows 11) and how to securely configure them at scale via MDM platforms (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Kandji).

Deep understanding of SSL certificates, PKI infrastructure, and credential management.

Solid networking fundamentals and understanding of secure network architecture (VLAN segmentation, Zero Trust Network Access/ZTNA, Firewalls, WiFi security).

Scripting proficiency in languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate security operations and log ingestion.

Experience with modern endpoint protection tools (EDR/XDR) and log management/SIEM platforms.

jobs.description:
IT Systems Engineer – Disaster Recovery & Infrastructure
Location: Chaska, MN (Onsite)

Position Summary: We are seeking an experienced IT Systems Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team in Chaska, Minnesota. This role will serve as a key technical resource responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting highly available enterprise infrastructure with a strong emphasis on Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity, Backup & Recovery, and Infrastructure Resiliency. The ideal candidate will have deep experience developing and maintaining enterprise disaster recovery strategies, supporting backup and replication technologies, leading recovery testing, and ensuring critical business systems remain available in the event of outages or disasters. In addition to disaster recovery responsibilities, this engineer will support enterprise virtualization, Microsoft infrastructure, hybrid cloud platforms, and infrastructure modernization initiatives while partnering with Architecture, Security, Network, Application, and IT teams.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the primary technical resource for Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity initiatives across enterprise infrastructure.
Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise disaster recovery strategies and recovery procedures.
Administer enterprise backup, replication, recovery, archive, and disaster recovery platforms utilizing Cohesity.
Lead disaster recovery planning, documentation, testing exercises, and recovery validation to ensure business continuity objectives are achieved.
Develop and maintain Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) for critical systems.
Coordinate infrastructure recovery efforts during planned testing and production incidents.
Implement, administer, maintain, and support Cisco HyperFlex and Cisco UCS infrastructure.
Administer VMware vSphere and ESXi environments supporting mission-critical enterprise workloads.
Administer Microsoft infrastructure including Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, MECM, and SCOM.
Support Microsoft Azure services and hybrid cloud infrastructure initiatives.
Perform infrastructure lifecycle management including upgrades, patching, capacity planning, performance tuning, and technology refresh activities.
Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, and resiliency while troubleshooting complex production issues.
Lead or participate in infrastructure modernization, migration, and operational improvement projects.
Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, disaster recovery documentation, and infrastructure standards.
Collaborate closely with Security, Network, Architecture, Application, and IT teams on enterprise infrastructure initiatives.
Coordinate with vendors, consultants, and service providers as needed.
Participate in an on-call rotation supporting production infrastructure.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
5+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering experience.
Strong experience designing, implementing, and supporting Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity solutions within enterprise environments.
Experience administering enterprise backup, replication, and recovery platforms (Cohesity strongly preferred).
Experience planning and executing disaster recovery testing and validating recovery procedures.
5+ years administering Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure.
5+ years supporting VMware vSphere and ESXi.
Experience supporting Cisco UCS, Cisco HyperFlex, or comparable enterprise compute platforms.
Experience administering Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, MECM, and SCOM.
Experience supporting Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments.
Strong understanding of high availability architecture, enterprise storage, virtualization, networking, and cloud technologies.
Experience performing infrastructure planning, implementation, monitoring, lifecycle management, and operational support.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting critical production systems.
Ability to participate in an on-call support rotation.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading enterprise Disaster Recovery programs or serving as the primary DR technical resource.
Microsoft certifications (Azure Administrator, Windows Server, Active Directory, Infrastructure Administration).
VMware Certified Professional (VCP).
Cohesity certification or significant enterprise backup experience.
CCNA or equivalent networking certification.
Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops administration experience.
Experience supporting manufacturing or other large enterprise environments.
Experience working within global enterprise organizations.
Project management experience or PMP certification.
Understanding of application, database, and enterprise system architecture.
Experience integrating on-premises, hybrid cloud, SaaS, and hosted business systems.

Why This Role?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in strengthening enterprise infrastructure resiliency and ensuring business continuity across a complex IT environment. You'll partner with infrastructure, security, and architecture teams to design and maintain highly available systems while leading Disaster Recovery initiatives that directly support business operations.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

WHAT IS AIS?
Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:
The Anduril Intelligence Systems System Administrator ensures the smooth functioning of the core underpinnings of the information system under management. This position provides direct onsite customer support:

- Install, configure, and maintain network, computer, and software systems.

- Manage user accounts, system permissions, and policies to ensure compliance with customer policies.

- Support new hardware selection, acquisition, installation, and configuration.

- Perform regular backup operations and exercise disaster recovery procedures.

- Maintain technical documentation of system configurations, changes, and procedures.

- Contribute to development and deployment of system scripts and tools to automate routine tasks to enhance system efficiency.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience maintaining and upgrading physical hardware (e.g. workstations, servers, laptops, network switches) in classified IT systems.

- Strong understanding of system updating for both Windows and Linux operating systems.

- Prior installation and administration of Linux (e.g. RedHat, CentOS, Debian, etc. ).

- Administration of Windows servers and workstations, including Active Directory and Group Policy management.

- Knowledge and experience of scripting languages (e.g. Powershell and Bash).

- Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms: VMWare, KVM, Hyper-V.

- Ability to work collaboratively and independently to address customer problems.

- Must work five days a week onsite at a customer site located in Northern Virginia.

- Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance with Full Scope Polygraph

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience providing system administrator support to classified IT systems

- Significant experience in maintaining/upgrading system hardware and startup/shutdown of rack components.

- Experience applying OS updates, anti-virus/anti-spyware updates, and Application updates in a classified environment.

- Ability to locate user session data via the command line.

- Experience with a scripting language (Bash, Python, etc.) to automate and solve reoccurring tasks

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to provide direct customer support.

US Salary Range

$112,000 - $149,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Join a team focused on strengthening and scaling iOS device deployment operations through Microsoft Intune in a large enterprise environment. This role is ideal for an Intune specialist who enjoys improving reliability, building repeatable processes, and creating the visibility needed to support secure mobile device management at scale.

Remote (PST & EST preferred)

Responsibilities

Audit existing Microsoft Intune configurations for iOS app deployment, app protection, app configuration, VPP/ABM integration, and rollout settings.
Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities to improve the reliability and repeatability of mobile app deployments.
Implement process improvements for app version management, phased rollouts, and rollback procedures across managed devices.
Partner with mobile engineering and IT teams to document and operationalize deployment workflows.
Build and support pre-release validation for Intune-deployed builds across MAM/MDM policies, conditional access, enrollment paths, device types, and OS versions.
Create monitoring, dashboards, alerts, and reports to track deployment success, install issues, policy compliance, and version adoption.
Support cross-functional collaboration by translating technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Help establish a stable foundation for ongoing operational support after the initial assessment and buildout phase.

Skills

Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune for iOS in an enterprise setting.
Strong knowledge of mobile device management, including enrollment, authentication, compliance, certification, and security practices.
Deep understanding of the Apple ecosystem, including ABM, VPP, APNs certificates, and app distribution.
Proven ability to support large-scale device management environments with complex requirements.
Experience advising on Intune architecture, deployment approaches, and operational best practices.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to collaborate effectively with support, product, engineering, and customer success teams.
Comfort working as a trusted subject matter expert in a consultative role.

Preferred Skills

Experience supporting enterprise-grade iOS environments in organizations with complex mobility needs.
Familiarity with building dashboards, alerts, and runbooks for deployment operations.
Experience with testing and validating policy behavior across a variety of device and OS configurations.
Background working in environments where repeatable processes and operational scaling are priorities.
Ability to thrive in a fast-moving setting with a focus on documentation, process improvement, and cross-team alignment.

Infrastructure Engineer

About the Role: We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to support a mid-to-large enterprise client across education, healthcare, enterprise, and service provider environments. This role centers on VMware virtualization and enterprise storage upgrade projects, blended with hands-on troubleshooting and customer-facing engagements - including discovery sessions, solution reviews, technical workshops, and sales support conversations. The ideal candidate has deep, current expertise in vSphere/ESXi environments and SAN/NAS storage refreshes, and is equally comfortable leading a storage migration in the data center as presenting a solution roadmap to a client stakeholder.

What You'll Do

Lead VMware vSphere/ESXi and vCenter design, deployment, and upgrade projects, including version upgrades, cluster builds, and environment modernization
Plan and execute enterprise storage upgrades and migrations (SAN/NAS), including capacity planning, platform refreshes, and data migration between storage tiers/vendors
Manage workload migrations and HA/DRS configuration across virtualized environments
Design, deploy, and troubleshoot enterprise networking environments (routing, switching, WAN/LAN)
Lead WLAN design and wireless deployments, including RF site surveys and analysis
Configure and support firewall/VPN solutions across multiple vendor platforms
Perform advanced network troubleshooting using packet capture and protocol analysis tools
Administer and support Microsoft infrastructure (Windows Server, AD, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, Certificate Services)
Lead Microsoft 365 and cloud initiatives, including migrations and identity/security configuration
Design and implement backup and disaster recovery solutions
Partner directly with clients on discovery calls, solution design sessions, technical workshops, and sales support conversations - particularly around virtualization and storage upgrade roadmaps

Must-Have Qualifications

Data Center, Virtualization & Storage (Primary Focus)

Strong, hands-on VMware vSphere/ESXi and vCenter administration, including version upgrade planning and execution
Proven experience leading enterprise storage upgrade or migration projects (SAN/NAS) - platforms such as HPE Alletra, Nimble, NetApp, Dell EMC, Synology, or similar
Cluster design, workload migrations, and HA/DRS configuration
Nutanix AHV and/or Hyper-V experience a plus

Networking

Enterprise routing/switching: TCP/IP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, Carrier Ethernet
WAN/LAN architecture design and implementation
WLAN design and deployment experience, including RF analysis tools and platforms such as Aruba, Extreme, or Cisco
Firewall/VPN experience with Fortinet, SonicWall, and/or Juniper
Advanced troubleshooting skills, including packet capture/trace analysis and protocol analyzers

Microsoft Infrastructure & Cloud

Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, Certificate Services
Microsoft 365 migrations, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online
Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, Microsoft Defender

Backup & DR

Veeam and/or Microsoft 365 Backup
Disaster recovery and business continuity planning

Communication

Strong customer-facing communication skills, with experience running discovery calls, solution design sessions, and presentations - especially explaining storage and virtualization upgrade options to non-technical stakeholders

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

VMware-to-Nutanix migration experience
Storage assessment/health check and capacity planning experience
Carrier-grade/service provider infrastructure experience
Azure hybrid cloud integration and identity synchronization
Mentoring, team leadership, or training development background
Cross-functional project leadership experience

About the Role:
As a CBRE MDM Sr Principal Engineer, you will be at the forefront of transforming CBRE's enterprise data landscape, with Master Data Management central to this initiative. You will take ownership of our Reltio MDM platform, serving as the ultimate subject matter expert for all Reltio-related aspects. You will architect data models, design complex match/merge rules, and drive the technical vision for MDM across the entire enterprise. This high-impact individual contributor role, reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data Governance and Engineering, requires you to bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, ensuring our master data is accurate, connected, and scalable. You will be embedded within a 20-person governance and engineering team, playing a crucial role in our data evolution.
This job is part of the Software Engineering job function. They are responsible for successfully executing and monitoring system improvements to increase efficiency.
What You’ll Do:
Architect and build enterprise-grade Master Data Management solutions natively within Reltio, owning the platform end-to-end.Design and configure complex L3 configurations, match/merge rules, survivorship frameworks, and data quality workflows.Define and maintain the MDM data model across CBRE’s core entity domains — clients, properties, counterparties, and organizations — ensuring models are scalable as new domains onboard.Establish and govern MDM engineering standards for configuration, naming conventions, API usage, and environment management (dev/test/prod).Lead technical integrations between Reltio, Snowflake, AWS, and upstream/downstream systems using SnapLogic and direct API patterns.Build and maintain data synchronization pipelines that keep master data consistent across the CBRE data estate — from source systems through to Snowflake and governed data products.Partner with the Collibra Engineering Lead to ensure Reltio entity data is accurately reflected in the data catalog, lineage, and governance metadata.Partner with the DQ Engineering Lead to ensure MDM entity resolution and survivorship outputs are monitored and quality-scored within SODA.Collaborate with the Principal AI Engineer to integrate LLM-based entity matching, deduplication, and enrichment capabilities into Reltio workflows.Evaluate and implement AI-assisted MDM capabilities — intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship decisions, and anomaly flagging — to reduce manual stewardship burden at scale.Ensure AI-generated MDM outputs are governed, auditable, and validated against CBRE’s data quality and governance standards before promotion to master.Set the standard for MDM best practices, data modeling, and governance standards across the team.Build UI/UX experiences for data stewards — workflows, dashboards, and issue queues in Reltio that make stewardship intuitive and efficient.Act as the senior technical voice on MDM in cross-functional forums — architecture reviews, data product launches, and governance councils.Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Navigate objections and disagreements. Set the tone for teams to reach an agreement and adopt a different point of view. Negotiate with senior and executive management, customers, regulators, or vendors to influence decisions of visionary and strategic importance.Apply ingenuity and creativity to problem analysis and resolution in complicated and/or novel situations.
What You’ll Need:
To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
Bachelor's Degree preferred with 10+ years of relevant experience in Master Data Management (MDM) implementation at an enterprise scale. Deep expertise in Reltio MDM solutions, including extensive hands-on experience with L3 configuration, Reltio API, and UI configuration.Mastery of MDM concepts, entity resolution, graph databases, and data governance frameworks.Proficiency with modern data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and integration platforms (e.g., SnapLogic, REST APIs).Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable Reltio data models and survivorship workflows.Strong leadership and communication skills, capable of driving technical projects from concept to production and explaining complex MDM concepts to diverse stakeholders.Independent judgment skills to determine methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for measuring success.Ability to recognize and resolve situations of substantial significance in a field of expertise or knowledge. In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. Must be meticulously organized and have a masterful inquisitive mindset.

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. ## Meet the team:

The Endpoint Engineering team is a global organization responsible for the design, standardization, and lifecycle management of corporate, R&D, and manufacturing endpoints. We operate with a strong focus on security, reliability, and user experience, balancing modern management practices with the unique requirements of regulated and manufacturing environments.

The team partners closely with Security, Infrastructure, Manufacturing IT, and R&D to deliver consistent, scalable, and compliant endpoint solutions worldwide. We lead the development of endpoint standards and best practices, ensuring devices are secure, supportable, and aligned with business and operational needs.

##

* You define and own the technical direction and standards for Windows and macOS endpoints across Corporate, R&D, and Manufacturing environments.
* You design scalable, secure, and supportable endpoint architectures using modern management platforms such as Intune, MECM, and Jamf.
* Lead and manage complex endpoint projects from planning to execution.
* You partner with Security, Infrastructure, Manufacturing IT, and R&D teams to ensure endpoint solutions meet compliance, validation, and audit requirements.

* Your proficiency in endpoint security, hardening, and configuration management enables you to reduce risk while maintaining a positive user experience.
* You excel at troubleshooting complex endpoint issues and translating root cause analysis into durable engineering solutions.
* You bring the ability to influence without authority, clearly communicating technical direction and mentoring other engineers through design reviews and best‑practice guidance.

jobs.description:
Thinking Machines Lab's mission is to empower humanity through advancing collaborative general intelligence. We're building a future where everyone has access to the knowledge and tools to make AI work for their unique needs and goals.
We are scientists, engineers, and builders who’ve created some of the most widely used AI products, including ChatGPT and Character.ai, open-weights models like Mistral, as well as popular open source projects like PyTorch, OpenAI Gym, Fairseq, and Segment Anything.
About the Team
The IT team builds secure infrastructure and efficient processes that enable our employees to move quickly. We operate an all-Mac environment and manage our endpoint fleet as a distributed platform, applying production-engineering practices to device management and security.
Our endpoint configurations, security policies, scripts, and software deployments are increasingly managed through version-controlled workflows with testing, review, staged rollouts, and rollback capabilities. This role will work closely with IT, Security, Identity, and Infrastructure to deliver a secure and reliable employee computing experience.
What You’ll Do

Endpoint Configuration as Code: Author, review, test, and progressively deploy macOS configuration profiles, security policies, queries, and remediation scripts. Build code review, staging, canary, validation, and rollback processes into endpoint changes.
MDM Platform Engineering: Operate our MDM platform as a production service, including configuration as code, observability, upgrades, reliability, incident response, and integrations with other IT and Security systems.
MDM Migration: Lead the evaluation, design, testing, and execution of our planned migration from Iru to Fleet. Establish functional requirements, identify configuration and security-control gaps, develop a phased migration plan, and move the fleet with minimal disruption to employees.
Santa and Rudolph: Own the architecture and operation of Santa and its Rudolph synchronization service. Manage binary-authorization policies, rule distribution, application approvals, telemetry, observability, infrastructure, and incident response.
Zero Trust and Device Trust: Partner closely with Security and Identity to make device trust a core component of our Zero Trust architecture. Integrate endpoint posture signals into authentication, authorization, and conditional-access decisions.
Continuous Posture Evaluation: Build systems that continuously evaluate device health and security posture, including MDM enrollment, OS version, patch status, disk encryption, endpoint protection, security-control status, and configuration compliance. Automatically identify and remediate drift or restrict access when a device no longer meets requirements.
Patch Management: Build and maintain automated macOS patching workflows that support rapid enforcement timelines while providing a thoughtful employee experience.
Zero-Touch Provisioning: Design and improve Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment workflows that turn a new Mac into a secure, fully configured, and productive machine with minimal manual intervention.
Software Distribution: Own application packaging, deployment, updating, and removal across the Mac fleet.
Fleet Telemetry and Compliance: Query live device state at scale and turn endpoint telemetry into actionable policies, dashboards, compliance reporting, and early warnings for configuration drift.
Automation: Build tools and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive operational work and make endpoint management more reliable and scalable.
Endpoint Security: Partner with Security on macOS hardening, binary authorization, vulnerability management, compliance controls, detection and response, and device-based access policies.
Advanced Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for complex macOS and endpoint-platform issues that cannot be resolved through standard IT support processes.
Technical Leadership: Help define the endpoint roadmap, evaluate technologies, make architecture decisions, and lead complex initiatives from conception through production.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience building and operating secure IT or endpoint systems in complex environments.
Experience managing a large fleet of macOS devices through a modern MDM platform.
Experience managing endpoint configuration through scripted deployments, Git-based workflows, or a full GitOps model.
Deep knowledge of macOS internals, enterprise deployment, security controls, and troubleshooting.
Experience designing and operating zero-touch Mac provisioning, patching, and software-distribution workflows.
Experience using device health and security signals to evaluate endpoint compliance.
Experience successfully delivering complex technical projects from conception through production.
Strong ability to solve ambiguous problems involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
Ability to communicate

jobs.description:
GAQ125R25

As Head of Corporate Engineering, you will be responsible for Enterprise engineering and operations globally. You will be responsible for building and managing a highly technical enterprise engineering team, developing first principled-based strategies, and enabling strong enterprise security. Key responsibilities include engineering, securing and optimizing cloud infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, Endpoints, Collaboration tools, and ensuring compliance with SOX, PCI DSS, and FedRAMP compliance. The Head of Corporate Engineering will work closely with R&D on managing engineering tools like Jira, Confluence, and GitHub, driving efficient adoption and integration. Strong technical and influencing leadership principles coupled with the ability to manage a complex, scaling, and fast-moving enterprise environment are essential.

This role reports directly to the Vice President, Infrastructure and Operations

Responsibilities:

In this influential role, you will be responsible for:

- Securing the Enterprise: Working closely with Enterprise Security organization to harden and secure our cloud environments, secret management, collaboration tools, endpoints, SaaS environments, IAM tools, and more. Success measured in continuous improvement of our enterprise security hardening standards

- Building and Scaling our Cloud Infrastructure : Your team will be responsible for establishing and implementing enterprise cloud infrastructure including establishing Infrastructure Provisioning, SRE services, 24/7 on-call support, Infra as Code, observability, and more. In addition, you will be responsible for managing cloud budgets, vendor management, and establishing cost optimization initiatives. Success is measured in increased developer velocity while securing & scaling the cloud infrastructure

- Engineering Tooling : Partner closely with R&D teams to establish policies, configurations, run-books, SLAs, hardening, scalability and availability of engineering tools like Github, Jira, Atlassian, and more

- Endpoint Engineering : Enable extreme automation for endpoint management with zero-touch deployment, observability (synthetic and real-time), provisioning/de-provisioning, and establishing standards / SLAs. Enforce security policies, configure & manage security settings and ensure compliance across all endpoints and mobile devices. Success is measured in terms of end-user satisfaction and % of manual touch.

- Collaboration Management : Ensure we provide world class tools to our employees to be extremely productive and collaborative. This would include but not be limited to managing and scaling internal workplace products like Gmail, Slack, Atlassian, Moveworks, Glean, and more. Success is measured by user satisfaction

- Identity & Access Management : Manage the IAM team from IAM implementation, access standards enforcement, SLA management, and compliance to various standards like FedRamp, IL5, PCI, and more. Included are both internal and external identity providers to be managed. Success is measured by compliance, Identity governance, and availability

Desired Success Outcomes

- A high-performing enterprise engineering team capable of handling complex technical projects with agility and high quality.

- Well defined cloud strategy ensuring the stability, scalability, and security of cloud infrastructure. Overhaul of current processes and workflows to address inefficiencies and increase team velocity.

- Robust endpoint security with Implementation of comprehensive security measures for all endpoints, including Mac, Windows, and mobile devices.

- Deliver high-quality employee experience with productivity tools (Gmail, Slack, Atlassian tools, Moveworks, GitHub) with a robust forward-looking roadmap.

- Efficient operational support for Tier 3 IT services with minimized production incidents. Implementation of robust incident and change management processes with mature operational practice

- Efficient and mature processes for system integrations related to Mergers and Acquisitions (M&As), ensuring timely smooth transitions during M&A integrations.

- Development and implementation of automation tools and frameworks, Identification of automation opportunities to reduce manual toil and improve accuracy.

Qualifications:

- 10 years of experience managing Cloud infrastructure at large enterprises. Extensive experience managing public cloud implementations in AWS. Experience with GCP and Azure will be a plus.

- In-depth understanding of Cloud native technologies to lead and guide the team. Must have hands-on experience in troubleshooting and debugging issues in production environments

- Working experience in managing DevOps/SRE practices OKRs (Objective and Key Results), Agile development, Infra-as-code, SRE (Site Reliability Engineering), DevOps measurement such as DORA KPIs,

- In-depth understanding of each collaboration tool's features, functionalities, and configurations (e.g., Gmail for email, Slack for messaging). Ability to identify and integrate and optimize the use of various tools for seamless collaboration (e.g., connecting Jira with GitHub for Dev metrics).

- Experience leading a team of senior professionals working asynchronously in a remote, distributed team. Strong communication skills, with clear verbal communication and written communication skills.

- Collaborative style: partners well with cross-functional teams to solve hard problems and to complete complex deliverables with quality and business outcomes.

- Provide mentorship and guidance to team members to ensure that their skills and knowledge are kept up-to-date

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SYSTEMS ENGINEER (ENDPOINT)

SpaceX is seeking an experienced IT Systems Engineer to join the Endpoint team. This multi-disciplinary role is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating modern endpoint management infrastructure with deep expertise in Jamf, Fleet, Intune, and Entra Conditional Access, while providing strong cross-platform support across Apple macOS, iOS, and Windows 11 / Windows Server environments.

The position requires building secure, compliant, and highly automated solutions at scale. The ideal candidate brings significant experience with enterprise device management platforms, advanced scripting and automation, observability through Splunk, and a forward-looking approach to incorporating AI workflows to improve security, efficiency, and compliance.

Candidates will work in a fast-paced environment supporting mission-critical systems. They should be self-starters who thrive on solving complex problems, driving standards, and enabling other teams through excellent documentation and automation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Architect, implement, and manage Jamf, Fleet, Microsoft Intune, and Entra Conditional Access policies to enforce zero-trust principles and device compliance across the fleet

- Design, deploy, and maintain endpoint configurations, compliance policies, application deployments, and security baselines for Windows 11, Windows Server, macOS, and iOS devices

- Develop and maintain advanced automation using PowerShell, Bash, and AppleScript to handle provisioning, configuration management, patching, remediation, and reporting at enterprise scale

- Integrate telemetry from Intune, Jamf, and other endpoint platforms with Splunk to deliver real-time monitoring, alerting, compliance dashboards, and support for security investigations

- Implement, audit, and maintain endpoint controls aligned with CIS benchmarks while ensuring strict adherence to ITAR and EAR regulatory requirements for devices, configurations, and data handling

- Evaluate, pilot, and operationalize AI-powered workflows and tools (including LLM-assisted scripting, intelligent policy analysis, and automated remediation) to increase efficiency and reduce risk

- Collaborate closely with Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to define endpoint standards, drive configuration and patch compliance across endpoint platforms, and support audits involving endpoint platforms and systems

- Create and maintain high-quality documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles; provide training and tier-3 escalation support to IT and support teams

- Lead or significantly contribute to major endpoint projects such as OS migrations, Entra Conditional Access expansions, new platform integrations, and automation platform improvements

Job Description

The Senior Endpoint Engineer role is responsible for designing, deploying, managing, troubleshooting, and maintaining endpoint device configurations and endpoint management systems. The role involves analyzing complex technical challenges and developing appropriate solutions to maintain the overall integrity of the endpoint ecosystem. This includes devices such as desktops, laptops, tablets, and mobile devices critical to the company’s global workforce. They collaborate with other IT professionals such as Service Support Teams, Network Engineers, and Cybersecurity Teams, to ensure endpoint devices and management systems are integrated seamlessly and securely within the broader IT infrastructure. The Senior Endpoint Engineer uses their extensive expertise in endpoint management platforms and supporting technologies to optimize device performance, ensure compliance, and enhance the end-user experience.

Responsibilities

Manage vendor relationships to ensure effective procurement, deployment, and support of endpoint devices, tools and management platforms.

Administer Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and Microsoft infrastructure services.
Support operating system deployments, migrations, upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.
Integrate Windows infrastructure with virtualization, storage, and cloud environments.
Administer Windows Server operating systems across multiple security enclaves.
Manage enterprise authentication, file, print, and certificate services.
Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, backup, and disaster recovery.
Implement DISA STIG-compliant configurations.
Support RMF, A&A, vulnerability remediation, POA&M activities, and audit readiness.
Apply security patches and maintain secure baselines.
Provide Tier III engineering support for enterprise Windows infrastructure.

Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, PowerShell, VMware integration, backup and recovery, and enterprise patch management.

Advanced expertise with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, VMware integration, enterprise patch management, backup and recovery, and disaster-recovery planning.
Demonstrated experience automating Windows infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and security compliance using PowerShell, Desired State Configuration, Infrastructure-as-Code, and Checklist-as-Code methodologies.

Who we are:

Farm Credit Bank of Texas is a $42.2 billion wholesale bank that has been financing agriculture and rural America for over 100 years. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we provide funding and services to rural lending associations in five states, and we are active in the nation's capital markets.

While you may not be familiar with our name, Farm Credit Bank of Texas plays a critical role in supporting the businesses that make it possible for America to maintain access to an affordable and safe food supply, an industry which is one of the most innovative and evolving of our time. And while you help us deliver on our mission, we deliver on our commitment to you as a valued employee by providing competitive compensation, generous health and wellness benefits packages and an attractive workplace located along the bluffs of the Colorado River just minutes west of downtown Austin.

We seek out top talent in their fields, whether it be technology, finance, accounting, credit, human resources, or other administrative functions, and welcome you to join us in our mission to feed the world.

Position Description:

The End-User Computing Engineer is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and securing the Bank's End-User Computing (EUC) environment. This role serves as a technical resource for the implementation, management, optimization, and troubleshooting of enterprise desktop technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure, endpoint management platforms, and related end-user services.

Working as part of the Information Technology team, the End-User Computing Engineer collaborates closely with Customer Support, Infrastructure Services, Information Security, and other technology teams to maintain reliable, secure, and efficient EUC services. The role provides advanced technical expertise, third-tier support, and engineering solutions that improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance the overall user experience.

The position focuses on ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of the Bank's endpoint computing environment through proactive administration, automation, and continuous improvement. The End-User Computing Engineer leverages technical expertise to support modern workplace technologies, streamline operations, and deliver solutions that align with the Bank's business objectives and technology strategy.

Operating with a high degree of ownership and accountability, the End-User Computing Engineer identifies improvement opportunities, resolves complex technical issues, implements technology enhancements, and helps ensure that employees have secure and reliable access to the systems and tools they need to perform their work effectively.

Day-to-Day Duties and Responsibilities:

Monitor and maintain enterprise EUC services to ensure acceptable levels of performance, reliability, and availability.
Perform advanced troubleshooting, problem resolution, and preventative maintenance for desktop, endpoint, and virtual desktop technologies.
Provide third-tier technical support and technical guidance to Customer Support and other IT teams.
Administer and support desktop operating systems, endpoint management platforms, mobile devices, and related technologies.
Enhance system security through endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and security-focused engineering practices.
Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational support materials.
Create and maintain automation solutions and scripts that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and optimize operational processes.
Manage assigned EUC systems and services, ensuring consistent performance, support, maintenance, and lifecycle management.
Track work requests, operational activities, incidents, and project tasks through the Bank's IT service management processes.
Communicate infrastructure updates, maintenance activities, and technology changes to management, support teams, and end users as appropriate.
Support operating system and application deployment, patching, packaging, and update management activities.
Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure Services, and application teams to support technology initiatives, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement efforts.
Participate in the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new technologies that improve the employee computing experience and support the Bank's strategic objectives.

What You Bring to the Team:

Our ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments and enjoys working in a collaborative, customer-focused technology organization dedicated to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

This role requires a combination of endpoint engineering, systems administration, automation, troubleshooting, and customer service expertise, including:

Associate's degree, technical school certification, or equivalent technical experience.
Professional certifications in Microsoft, Omnissa, VMware, or related technologies preferred.
Three (3) or more years of experience as a Systems Administrator, Systems Engineer, End-User Computing Engineer, or similar technology role.
Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and experience may be considered.
Experience administering enterprise Windows environments, desktop platforms, and endpoint management solutions.
Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues.
Experience supporting desktop operating systems, mobile devices, endpoint security, and end-user productivity tools.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of service, accuracy, and attention to detail.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across cross-functional technology teams.
Commitment to operational excellence, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality technical support and engineering solutions.

Preferred:

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Experience with PowerShell scripting, automation, and systems management tools.
Experience supporting virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), including Omnissa Horizon, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop environments.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and automated platform management.
Experience with endpoint security technologies, vulnerability management, and remediation programs.
Experience supporting Windows 11, Microsoft 365 applications, and modern workplace technologies.
Experience with Windows Autopilot, device provisioning, and modern desktop deployment methodologies.
Experience administering cloud-based computing environments, including Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring solutions such as ControlUp.
Experience supporting collaboration and conferencing technologies including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco Webex, and related platforms.
Experience working within regulated financial services, banking, or highly controlled technology environments.

Active Top Secret/ Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance with ability to pass and obtain a Poly Clearance. Current CISSP or Security + Certification. Proven work experience as a Systems Engineer, Systems Admin or similar role in a large, distributed computing environment. Experience with data analysis tools, knowledge of system performance metrics, and familiarity with infrastructure management systems. Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Excellent problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of User Profile administration.

Desired Qualifications:

Active TS/SCI with Poly clearances. Current VMware, Nutanix, or similar Certification e.g. VCP, NCP, etc. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with Terraform or Ansible. Experience with Dell PowerFlex. Experience working in a large enterprise environment. Knowledge of storage area networks to include network operating systems, SAN protocols, SAN management, and SAN physical configuration. Minimum of 8-12 years’ experience, in supporting virtualization technologies preferred. Strong understanding of data center networking (TCP/IP, switching/routing, ports and protocols, firewall concepts, load-balancing). Strong Scripting experience in one or more of the following: PowerShell, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, VBScript, C++, Unix Shell, Python, Perl, Ruby, JavaScript, etc. Strong understanding of storage protocols (e.g. NFS, SMB, S3, FC, iSCSI, NVMe). Good knowledge of Active Directory, DHCP, DNS, Group Policy. Knowledge of MS Windows Server operating systems including Server 2016, 2019, and 2022 as well as RHEL and SLES operating systems. Knowledge of MS database server SQL Server 2008 R2 and later. Knowledge of container technologies including but not limited to Docker, Kubernetes, and Rancher. Knowledge of IaaS in cloud using MS Azure, AWS, or GCP.

SECURITY CLEARANCE:

This Position requires an Active TS/SCI and the ability to obtain a Poly, US Citizenship is required

To hold this clearance.

Job Description:

Peraton is seeking an experienced systems Virtual Desktop Systems Engineer to join our national intelligence program that delivers engineering, application development, deployment, operations, upgrades and sustainment of products and services to achieve our client’s global missions.

The Virtual Desktop Systems Engineer will have an emphasis on User Profiles.

Responsibilities:

Manage user accounts, permissions, licenses, and monitoring of system performance to proactively resolve technical issues. Analyze and interpret data to improve infrastructure performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions, to include monitoring system performance and troubleshooting issues to ensure compliance with performance standards. Ensure data security and compliance with industry standards and regulations. Maintain smooth operation of multi-user computer systems, including coordination with network engineers. Monitor and manage enterprise system resources, including CPU usage, disk usage, and response times to maintain operating efficiency. Assess and remediate the enterprise design and implementation to mitigate performance and cybersecurity risks. Perform systems security administration functions, including creating user profiles and accounts. Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 problem identification, diagnosis, and resolution of problems. Configure operating systems and support enterprise servers. Install and configure database and application software. Perform database backups and system restoration, monitor database performance, and perform troubleshooting. Interact with users and interfacing applications. Provide hardware and software backup recovery. Other duties may include setting up administrator accounts, maintaining system documentation, tune system performance, installing system wide software, and allocating mass storage space. Develop, implement and maintain processes, procedures, test cases, test results, issue resolutions, performance analysis, and user guidelines/ instructions documentation. Travel may be required within the National Capital Region (NCR) on an as needed basis for customer or corporate requirements.

Job Title: MSP Systems Engineer

Location: Hybrid, with flexibility for remote work and regular customer site visits as business needs require.

Salary Range: $80,000 to $105,000 DOE

Job Description:

As an MSP Systems Engineer, you’ll design, implement, secure, and support practical IT solutions across customer cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including networks, servers, endpoints, Microsoft 365/O365, Azure, and Entra ID. Your work will improve customer performance, security, documentation, and day-to-day reliability while giving our internal support team a strong escalation resource.

In this role you will:

· Provide advanced technical support to customers and internal teams for complex issues across networks, servers, endpoints, Microsoft 365/O365, Azure, and related systems.

· Design, implement, and document customer network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, wireless, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and secure remote access.

· Lead or assist with customer infrastructure projects such as network deployments, firewall replacements, wireless upgrades, server migrations, Microsoft 365 improvements, Azure/Entra ID configuration, and security hardening.

· Administer and support Microsoft 365/O365, Azure, and Entra ID environments, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, licensing, user lifecycle management, identity management, MFA, conditional access, groups, role-based access, and security settings.

· Serve as a key escalation resource for 1st and 2nd level support teams by resolving complex issues, improving documentation, and creating repeatable solutions that strengthen service delivery.

· Provide proactive technical guidance to customers, helping them prevent future issues, improve security posture, and plan for technology upgrades.

· Stay current on networking, Microsoft cloud, cybersecurity, and managed services technologies to help ABS deliver modern, secure, and effective solutions.

· Assist with other duties, projects, or team needs as appropriate.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

· 5+ years of experience in a managed service provider, systems engineering, network engineering, or similar IT environment.

· High school diploma or equivalent required.

· Strong experience designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and documenting customer network infrastructure.

· Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, switching, wireless networking, firewalls, network segmentation, and related network equipment.

· Experience administering Microsoft 365/O365, Azure, and Entra ID environments, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, licensing, identity management, MFA, conditional access, groups, role-based access, and security settings.

· Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, including servers, endpoints, cloud services, backups, cybersecurity, and monitoring tools.

· Understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices, including least privilege, secure remote access, endpoint protection, email security, and Microsoft cloud security controls.

· Excellent problem-solving, analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

· Valid NYS driver’s license, acceptable driving record, and reliable transportation for customer site visits.

· Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical customers in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred qualifications:

· Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, networking, cybersecurity, or a related field.

· Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft 365, Azure, Fortinet, Cisco, Ubiquiti, or similar.

· Familiarity with network monitoring, diagnostic, and documentation tools such as SNMP, Wireshark, RMM platforms, PSA systems, and IT documentation systems.

· Experience working in a managed service provider or customer-facing technical support environment.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities
About the Team
The IT Support team's mission is to empower our organization with innovative technology solutions that enhance productivity, streamline operations, and drive growth. The IT Support team partners with cross-functional teams across the organization to deliver reliable technical support, guidance, and solutions. We are committed to collaboration, service excellence, and making technology work seamlessly for our employees. Through collaboration and a commitment to excellence, we aim to make technology work seamlessly for our users, ultimately enabling them to focus on what matters most – delivering value to our organization and our customers.

About the Role
The Sr. Digital Workplace Technician would be providing general hardware and software to business users and working with stakeholders to remove friction and increase staff productivity through the use of AI and automation. Due to the nature of the technical work, the candidate will be required to provide resolutions to tickets and service requests from FTEs, BPOs, TPAs either onsite at a TT USDS JV office location or remote via Lark and if needed Google Chat.

Tasks and Responsibilities:
- Site Ownership: Serves as the technical lead for onsite and regional offices, overseeing site visits, office expansions
- Executive Cross-Functional Partnership: Acts as a professional IT ambassador, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Operations to align regional technology with global corporate objectives and AI-driven workflows.
- Elite Technical Support (Tier 1-3): Provides top-notch, white-glove support for both onsite and remote teams, acting as the final escalation point for complex hardware and software troubleshooting.
- Modern A/V & Live Stream Engineering: Owns the end-to-end setup and support of sophisticated A/V environments. Provides hands-on expertise with Logitech conference systems, Apple Mac Mini/iPad room controllers, Crestron control systems, and Lightware signal management.
- Standardization & Documentation: Authors technical standards, security policies, and "Golden Image" best practices for global deployment, ensuring consistency across all regional sites.
- Enterprise Service Management: Partners with service owners to evaluate and deploy enterprise solutions. Maintains Admin-level expertise across both Google Workspace and Microsoft Office 365 environments.
- Infrastructure & Data Integrity: Manages lifecycle, backups, and monitoring for critical office infrastructure. Directs technical input for enterprise projects, emphasizing "Infrastructure as Code" (IaC) principles.
- AI-Driven Efficiency & Automation: Proactively identifies operational gaps and builds solutions using AI tools (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) and automation platforms (Zapier, DevinAI) to eliminate manual tasks and improve user experience.
- Lifecycle & Procurement: Manages onsite supply chains and procurement of high-end technical assets, ensuring the office is equipped with the latest verified technology.
- Security & Compliance Champion: Maintains a high degree of awareness regarding cyber/information security, ensuring onsite hardware and networks adhere to Zero Trust frameworks.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Advanced IT Foundation: Extensive direct user-facing support experience within a high-growth or FAANG/MAANG-equivalent environment. Expert-level troubleshooting across Windows OS, macOS, and Unix/Linux environments.
- Education: College degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a relevant technical discipline.
- SaaS & Identity Mastery: Expert-level administration of Google Workspace and Microsoft Office 365. Deep familiarity with Google IAM, Active Directory, and Cloud-based identity providers.
- UEM Expertise: Mastery of Omnissa Workspace One for multi-OS deployment (macOS, Windows, iOS, Android) and policy management.
- Full-Stack Networking: Strong understanding of general networking (DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, TCP/IP) and hands-on familiarity with Cisco, Aruba, Palo Alto, and SDN technologies in MDF/IDF environments.
- AI & LLM Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to utilize Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, and DevinAI to write scripts, troubleshoot code, and automate workflows. Proficiency in Zapier for connecting disparate SaaS tools.

Preferred Qualifications
- Enterprise A/V Certifications: Relevant training or experience with Crestron programming or Lightware switching systems.
- Advanced Networking/Security: Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, MCSE, CompTIA Sec+, or CISSP.
- Infrastructure Automation: Experience with Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automating system administration tasks.
- Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure environments.
- Virtualization: Familiarity with VMware Horizon VDI or similar cloud-desktop solutions.
- Project Management: Proven experience managing large-scale IT office builds, moves, or global software migrations.

About USDS
TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.

On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

USDS Reasonable Accommodation
USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA

jobs.description:
Location: Amarillo, TX - Pantex Plant
Job Title: IT Senior Endpoint Engineer - Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) & Intune
Career Level From: Senior Associate
Career Level To: Senior Specialist
Organization: End User Computing (51130473)
Job Specialty: System Administration

What You'll Do

As a hands-on technical specialist, you will serve as the enterprise owner for endpoint management across Windows devices. Your primary responsibility will be the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Microsoft Intune, along with the Azure/Entra ID services that keep Intune resilient and secure. You will drive patch/update compliance, application and Operating System (OS) deployments, client health, and co‑management strategy Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM + Intune), while closely collaborating with Cybersecurity, Network, and Support teams to ensure reliability, security, and compliance of our endpoint fleet. You are responsible for maintaining a thorough knowledge of applicable Federal, State, Department of Energy (DOE), Corporate and Plant rules, regulations, and Plant-wide operating policies and procedures.

Essential Job Duties

Microsoft Core Infrastructure (MCM) Platform Ownership & Optimization

Own, administer, and continually optimize MCM core infrastructure (site server, Management Point (MP)/Distribution Point (DP) roles, Structured Query Language (SQL), Windows Server Update Services (WSUS)/Software Update Point (SUP), boundary groups, content distribution, and backup/disaster recovery (DR) `readiness).
Drive client‑health improvement using telemetry, automation, and consistent collection hygiene.
Enhance platform performance and scalability across multiple locations and networks.

OS Deployment (OSD) Engineering

Lead design, maintenance, and modernization of OSD task sequences for Windows 11.
Engineer efficient driver‑lifecycle management, secure imaging standards, pre‑provisioning (BitLocker), post‑install hardening, and automation to reduce build time and increase reliability.
Evaluate migration from traditional OSD to Autopilot‑first strategies where appropriate.

Software Packaging & Deployment

Establish packaging standards and best practices for Microsoft Installer (MSI)/Executable File (EXE)/Win32 deployments across MECM and Intune.
Build, test, and deploy applications at scale; optimize distribution‑point content placement and success‑rate visibility.
Expand capabilities using third‑party patch/catalog solutions to increase coverage.

Patch & Update Compliance

Lead monthly update cycles for Windows OS, Microsoft 365 Apps, and third‑party applications.
Rapidly remediate non‑compliant devices through automation and targeted deployments.
Ensure WSUS/SUP synchronization health and maintain a reliable update pipeline.

Intune & Modern Device Management

Own Intune configuration strategy, including Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and Windows Update for Business rings.
Implement and maintain Endpoint Security Baselines (BitLocker, Defender, firewall, attack surface reduction, Credential Guard).
Drive clarity and evolution of MECM/Intune workload split using co‑management and Tenant Attach.

Identity & Security Integration

Manage Entra ID (Azure AD) device identity, Conditional Access policies, role‑based access control, and SCEP/NDES/PKI integrations.
Ensure secure enrollment, compliance signaling, and alignment with cybersecurity requirements.

Automation, Monitoring & Troubleshooting

Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph Application Programming Interface (API), Kusto Query Language (KQL) (Log Analytics/Azure Monitor), and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)/Power Business Intelligence (BI) reporting to automate operations and improve visibility.
Troubleshoot complex endpoint failures (Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI), Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS), policy conflict, client registration, SUP sync, Cloud Management Gateway (CMG) connectivity) and deliver long‑term fixes.

Documentation & Leadership

Create and maintain enterprise runbooks, engineering standards, and troubleshooting guides.
Lead technical workshops, mentor peers, and contribute to continuous improvement of endpoint management processes.

Minimum Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering/science/information technology discipline: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience.
OR Master's degree in engineering/science/information technology discipline.
OR applicants without a bachelor's degree may be considered based on a combination of at least 10 years of completed education and/or relevant experience.

Department of Energy (DOE) Order 426.2A Requirements

Not applicable.

Preferred Job Requirements

Expert‑level experience with MCM administration, OSD engineering, software distribution, client health, and update compliance.
Strong experience with Intune, Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance/policy management, and Windows security baselines.
Deep PowerShell scripting capability, operational analytics knowledge (Log Analytics/KQL, SSRS, Power BI).
Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex Windows/MECM/Intune issues at scale.
Experience with CMG, Tenant Attach, and defining MECM/Intune co‑management workloads.
Experience optimizing MECM SQL performance and WSUS/SUP maintenance.
Work with Secure Communications Interoperability (SCUP) or third‑party patching solutions.
Relevant Microsoft certifications (MD‑102, SC‑300, AZ‑104, AZ‑500) or equivalent hands‑on proficiency.
